lidar: USGS CO_DRCOG_2_2020 (https://s3-us-west-2.amazonaws.com/usgs-lidar-public/CO_DRCOG_2_2020/ept.json), classes 2 (ground) and 17 (bridge deck), through tools/lidar_connector_profile.py's tile cache and reader

frame_scale.rule: tools/grid_reach.frame_scale: a drawn (grid-frame) x, z times KX, KZ is the lidar / lap frame's point at the same lon / lat

_doc: Item 2 (ledger 0098 'quebec_median': the median between the Northfield Quebec arms): grid_primary_78 and grid_primary_84#0#0 of tracks/sand-creek-lm/data/connectors.local.json (drawn in the grid's sphere frame), each read along its TRUE line (each drawn x, z times KX, KZ). +u = left of the arm's travel (78 runs from the I-70 end to the sandcreek_quebec pad, 84#0#0 from the pad north): the median is on the left of both. stations_list: every 2.5 m of the true line (s_true). rows_list: per drawn row: drawn_xz / drawn_y (the built point), true_xz, offset_true_minus_drawn (dx, dz, dist; along / u in the drawn piece's frame), the station read at the row, and for every face u_drawn_m (the face's true-frame point divided by KX, KZ, its lateral off the drawn point along the drawn normal: where to build it on the drawn line) and u_vs_drawn_point_as_lidar_m (the same face against the drawn point read as a lidar point: the 4.6 m frame gap included); median.top_minus_drawn_y_m: the real top minus the drawn row's y. built: the drawn widths_m, centred. faces: right_edge, median_near, median_far, left_edge (a station that is not divided has right_edge and left_edge, its far-face candidates under not_divided_candidates), each {u_m: + = left of travel, kind: curb | drop | fall | none (outer edges; a median face is curb | none), step_m (curb / drop: up / down outward; a median face: onto the median), y_minus_side / y_plus_side (the two side lines read at the face, heights in the lap's y), grade_inward_side / grade_outward_side, returns, real_minus_built_m (u minus the built edge on that side)}. A `none` face's u is where the trace ran, not a measurement. median: {near_face_u_m, far_face_u_m, width_m (face to face), top_y, top_over_near_side_m / top_over_far_side_m}; carriageways: near_m / far_m (divided) or one_m; real_width_m: outer edge to outer edge (both measured); per_50m: median / min / max / n.
